seo_title: VIES VAT Validation API: Automate Your B2B Invoicing
seo_desc: Wasting time checking European VAT numbers manually? We integrate the VIES API into your store to validate clients and apply VAT exemptions instantly.
author_pitch: I have seen small businesses receive tax fines for removing VAT for European clients who were not properly registered. My mission is to automate this process in the cloud so you can sell across Europe legally and without lifting a finger.
title: VIES Registry API Integration: Sell to European Companies Without Tax Risks
body:
Is your accountant warning you about issuing VAT-free invoices to European clients with invalid tax numbers?

Selling your products or services to other companies in Europe is great for your growth, but bureaucracy can sink you. If a client from France or Germany buys from you, you must manually check the European database (VIES) to see if their cross-border operator number is valid before removing the VAT. If you delay, the client abandons the cart. If you do it wrong and do not charge VAT to an unregistered company, the Tax Agency will demand that money from your own pocket.

The trap of manual verifications

Many entrepreneurs force their European clients to send an email, check the VAT number by hand on the government website, and then send a custom payment link. Paralyzing your international sales to do free administrative work destroys your capacity to grow.

Our solution: API Integration with the European VIES Network

At LANZAESTUDIO, we connect your online store or billing system directly to the European Commission's database using an ultra-fast cloud API.

  1. Split-Second Validation: The client enters their VAT number on your checkout page and the system queries Europe in real time, with no waiting periods.
  2. Dynamic Tax Calculation: If the VAT number is correct, the system automatically removes the VAT; if there is an error, it applies the corresponding local tax.
  3. Evidentiary Record for Tax Authorities: We save the official query code in your database, which legally protects you during any tax inspection.
  4. Synchronization with Your Accounting: The invoice is instantly generated with the validated data and sent to your accountant without human errors.

The Real Impact on Your Small Business

  • Absolute Tax Peace of Mind: You avoid claims and penalties by ensuring that every VAT-free sale strictly complies with European regulations.
  • Automated International Sales: Your European clients can buy in the middle of the night without relying on someone in your office to approve the transaction.
  • Administrative Hours Saved: You completely eliminate the need to log into government portals to cross-reference data manually.
